name: Stubcroft Farm Campsite
accommodation: 87 grass and hardstanding pitches, some electric
beachAccess: Coast about a 15–20 minute walk; under five minutes' drive
confirmedFeatures: Heated amenity block, shop, cafe, laundry, fire pits and BBQ hire, EV charging, some pitches open year round
overview: A farm campsite near East Wittering with 87 pitches, some open all year. The coast is roughly a 15 to 20-minute walk along quiet lanes, or a few minutes in the car, and there is a heated amenity block, shop and cafe.
surfTripFit: Year-round pitches make it useful for winter swells on the Witterings.
